preconditions.description: Number of test cases T is between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= K <= 1000000000000 for K in K_values)

postconditions.description: The number of output lines matches the number of test cases T.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(line, int) for line in output)
postconditions.description: Each output line is an integer.

postconditions.expression: all(is_magical_number(output[i], K_values[i]) for i in range(T))
postconditions.description: Each output number is the K-th magical number.
